remarks: Situated at the end of a quiet cul-de-sac, this 4-bedroom, 3.5-bath home offers the rare combination of privacy and convenience. Just minutes from all that Stamford has to offer-shopping, transportation, beaches, entertainment, and a wide variety of restaurants-you'll enjoy the best of suburban living with city amenities close at hand. This is truly a diamond in the rough, ready for someone with vision to bring it back to life. With its fabulous footprint and generous layout, the possibilities are endless. An investor or contractor will appreciate the solid bones and the opportunity to reimagine the space into a modern showpiece, while others will love the chance to create a home tailored to their own lifestyle and needs. Whether you envision an open-concept design, a multi-generational home, or simply a warm and inviting space to make memories, this property provides the perfect canvas. With strong potential and a desirable location, it's a rare find waiting for the right touch. Bring your creativity and make this house shine again-it's a project worth doing, and the results will be truly rewarding. Whatever contents are in the house as of the day of closing will convey with the sale. This is an "AS IS" sale.
